changes: Opening any page while signed out now takes you to the sign-in screen. Pages like Tasks, Group Tasks, Profile and Settings previously left you on an empty screen with no menu, and the only way out was to hand-edit the address bar back down to the site root.

After you sign in you are taken to the page you originally asked for, instead of always landing on the dashboard. A bookmark or a shared link to a specific page now works even when your session has expired.
You can now specify exact start and end times for overtime, offset leaves, and SIL leaves, rather than just the number of hours.
The system now prevents you from accidentally filing multiple leave or overtime applications that overlap with your own existing time windows on the same day.
The HR and personal leave boards now display specific time windows alongside the total hours.
The Pending Requests tab now shows all pending applications regardless of what month they are for, grouping them clearly by month.
Added a new 'Awaiting Decision' section at the top of your personal leaves and overtime tabs so you can easily track requests that HR hasn't processed yet.
You can now attach any common document types (PDFs, Word documents, Excel sheets, ZIP files) to chat messages and leave applications, in addition to images.
Cleaned up duplicated attachment preview code across task and chat components for better performance.

The SOR field previously labelled "Client" is now labelled "Company" everywhere it appears — the registration form, the SOR register, the details view, and the commission export. It always meant the organisation being sold to, not the person you deal with; the old label read both ways and was being filled in both ways.
Fetching a Sales Reference now fills the Company straight from the Odoo quotation, so it is the customer as recorded in Odoo rather than a name typed from memory.

The Contact Person is filled from the quotation too, but only when you have left it blank — a contact you typed yourself is never overwritten, since it often carries a mobile number or a working name Odoo does not hold.
If you had already typed a Company before fetching, an Undo appears beside the field to put your original text back.
The Sales Reference has moved to the top of the SOR form, above the fields it fills in. Leave it blank if the quotation does not exist yet — it is still only required to move from Lead to Qualified.
Fetching a quotation that exists but has no product lines yet now fills in the Company and tells you the products are missing, instead of reporting the whole lookup as a failure.
Fixed: opening an SOR whose Odoo quotation had no product lines could erase that SOR's saved Product List.
Fixed 14 existing SORs that had the Company and the Contact Person entered the wrong way round — the person's name in Company, the agency in Contact Person.
Fixed a bug where chat emoji reactions were not visible to receivers by applying proper RLS UPDATE policies for Realtime events.
Fixed a bug where group task chat reactions were not firing realtime events by adding committee_task_activity to the supabase_realtime publication and updating the subscription listener.
Fixed a bug where viewing a SOR would sometimes incorrectly log 'items updated' when nothing was actually modified.
Supported @ mentions for team members within the group task chat box.
Read receipts (avatars of users who have seen the message) are now displayed in group task chat.
